meta.entity_naming: S:<FN hex>:<var_key> matches flow_stores/eax_via_slots/SG slot naming; window entities S:<FN hex>:<var_key>@W0x<write insn addr> mirror the solver C19 SSA-split precedent S:fn:+off@C0xADDR. P:<FN>:<K> = param K of FN itself (K from arg_K/4 or (ebp+X-8)/4 under ebp-frame gate).
meta.semantics: stack-slot lifetime-window multi-write-source relaxation: each textual write to a slot key in F defines a lifetime window S:F:key@W0xADDR; a CFG reaching-definitions engine (may-join over var_/arg_ keys, must-join over register defs, callee-saved aliasing across calls, arithmetic kills value defs) attributes every slot load to its unique reaching write. W1: window whose defining write is a call-return carrier (mov [slot],reg with reg def=('CALL',G,cs); S->S unique-writer window chains chased, roots must be carrier) => S@W == EAX:F:cs. W2: write source is param passthrough (mov reg,[arg_K] with arg entry-def uniquely reaching) => S@W == P:F:K. W3 read-consumption: mov ecx,[slot] feeding a resolved thiscall callee (fn_takes_this | signals cc==thiscall) => S@W == T:callee. W4 read-consumption: mov r,[slot]; mov r2,[r]; call [r2+N] => S@W domain subset of classes whose main vtable (vtable_slot_authority) has slot N/4. Plain-entity promotion (no @W): slot with a single textual write of eligible form, or all writes carriers of one callee / all one argK.
meta.soundness: windows are single-write-source by construction (one textual write each); conservative branch of the relaxation spec: loads with !=1 reaching def produce no edges (rd_multi_load counted); truncated functions excluded entirely (same gate as eax_via_slots); non-converged dataflow demotes bindings per-channel (reg-unconverged demotes all bound writes, rd-unconverged drops slotcopy/argpass/reads); subreg/fpu/xchg/pop/rmw/imm/lea/other writes never emit eq edges; esp-numeric and ebp-numeric slot keys excluded (drift/odd-entity hygiene); arg numeric form gated by ebp prologue; EAX entities restricted to flow_chains universe, RET:G to flow_chains RET set; reaching attribution is CFG-path may-reach (path-feasibility ignored — same precision tier as ffl4/ffl5/eax_flow_equations). MUST NOT merge write sources across calls (a call overwriting EAX breaks the chain — arithmetic kills defs).
